mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(task_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','RETRY_PENDING')),0) pending,COALESCE(SUM(task_status='FAILED'),0) failed FROM t_jira_attachment_pull_task
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_jira_attachment_pull_task(feedback_source_id,jira_key,jira_updated_at) VALUES(#{sourceId},#{jiraKey},#{jiraUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_status=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,'PENDING',task_status),retry_count=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,0,retry_count),next_retry_at=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,next_retry_at),lease_holder=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,lease_holder),lease_expires_at=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,lease_expires_at),last_error_code=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,last_error_code),last_error_detail=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,last_error_detail),completed_at=IF(VALUES(jira_updated_at)>jira_updated_at,NULL,completed_at),jira_key=VALUES(jira_key),jira_updated_at=GREATEST(jira_updated_at,VALUES(jira_updated_at)),updated_at=NOW(3)

INSERT INTO t_jira_attachment_pull_task(feedback_source_id,jira_key,jira_updated_at) VALUES(#{sourceId},#{jiraKey},#{jiraUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_status='PENDING',retry_count=0,next_retry_at=NULL,lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,completed_at=NULL,jira_key=VALUES(jira_key),jira_updated_at=VALUES(jira_updated_at),updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_jira_attachment_pull_task WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING','PROCESSING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3)) AND (task_status<>'PROCESSING' OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_jira_attachment_pull_task SET task_status='PROCESSING',lease_holder=#{workerId},lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,jira_key,retry_count,max_retries FROM t_jira_attachment_pull_task WHERE lease_holder=#{workerId} AND task_status='PROCESSING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_jira_attachment_pull_task SET task_status='COMPLETED',lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,completed_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}

UPDATE t_jira_attachment_pull_task SET task_status=#{status},retry_count=#{retry},next_retry_at=IF(#{terminal},NULL,DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delay} SECOND)),lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code},last_error_detail=#{detail},completed_at=IF(#{terminal},NOW(3),NULL),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}

UPDATE t_jira_attachment_pull_task SET task_status='COMPLETED',lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,completed_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}
